scope: Independent source-only review of corrected, unexecuted finalization/closure/diagnostic publication controls. Does not claim final report, production publication, closure or diagnostic publication has occurred.
original_drafts: Original finalize.py, closure.py and diagnostic-publish.py remain preserved unexecuted and are not approved entrypoints.

resolved_findings.finding: Source-only review schema differs from accepted/findings/bindings schema.
resolved_findings.resolution: closure-reviewed.py separately validates provisional scope, resolved findings, source_bindings and prior_review_binding; actual production and numerical result admissions remain independently required.

resolved_findings.finding: Expected diagnostic refs and actual master branch/ref missing before finalization writes.
resolved_findings.resolution: finalize-reviewed.py checks branch master and master ref plus diagnostic branch, HEAD, tracking and live remote at expected original head before first mutation.

resolved_findings.finding: Diagnostic publisher did not revalidate actual master working source against tested/pinned tree immediately before staging.
resolved_findings.resolution: diagnostic-publish-reviewed.py calls verify_tested_trees before first git add and again before push; actual master branch/ref checked at staging preflight.

checks: Finalizer resolves each review binding exactly to current bytes or narrowly mapped original source/index beforeimage; current protected files and postintegration indexes checked before writes.

Finalizer requires exact published main refs, expected untouched diagnostic refs, matching GREEN/MASTER results and complete tested source/test trees before saving finalization observation or modifying continuation.
Original continuation files are copied before prepend; historical source/index mappings preserve exact original bindings; prior bytes remain verbatim suffix.

Final report distinguishes completed production verification from still-pending diagnostic closure/publication, uses inclusive completed elapsed, discloses A nonunit overhead and C inconclusive time benefit, and describes residual call frequency correctly.

Closure checks all actual production/numerical admissions, original rejected records, original and corrected manifests, exact historical resolution and tree membership, preserved old tests, same whole-file results, current indexes and all protected user files.
Closure validates narrow PLAN/WORK-MEMORY/DESIGN beforeimages without rewriting originals and freshly checks group/session process state before its exclusive PASS record.

Publisher requires accepted closure/final review, current closure bindings, exact diagnostic/main refs and approved endpoint, protected files/indexes and actual tested/pinned master tree before staging.

Publisher stages explicit closed artifacts only, checks exact path/blob set before commit and again after commit, preserves inherited diagnostic whitespace only under its specific path rule, checks sole parent and protected state, rechecks tested trees, and normally pushes without force followed by remote/tracking verification.
All publication mutations use checked subprocesses; failures prevent later commit/push steps. Exclusive publication-plan and closure outputs prevent silent overwrites.
remaining: Actual GREEN/MASTER and actual commit reviews.
Actual closure and diagnostic publication outcome verification.
